Executed a search across project and staging tiers using the keyword string 'D3 ALA anchor ripple', which is split into individual words and matched independently. The search returned 40 total entries: project tier entries (MM-GBSA pharmacophore, per-residue decomposition, N-terminal extension candidates, superposition rule) listed first, followed by staging tier entries (ripple effect linking D3→ALA to strengthened L4/Q5, RKALQ register shift, ALA methyl steric wedge, entity10 binding register, D3 mutation panel design). The observed ordering confirms that project-tier results are prioritized over staging-tier results. Caveat: This reflects the search functionality and current knowledge-base population, not a direct experimental finding.
